title: Heatmap + Micro-interaction Quickstart: Observability screenshots for latency, token-cost, and trace anomalies
creator: Ava Chen
description: Create a compact set of Quickstart screenshots and micro-interaction assets that demonstrate: 1) a latency heatmap view highlighting hotspots across routes and models; 2) a per-token cost sparklines panel with hover states showing cost breakdown (model, quantization, caching); and 3) a compact trace ribbon / anomaly spotlight that surfaces slow requests with linked traces. Assets should be suitable for docs, in-app quickstart, and the release notes visual pack.
design_notes: Primary goal: communicate operational signal in a single compact canvas for new users during first-run onboarding.
Use 3 visual tiers: global heatmap (routes x time), route detail flyout (latency distribution + p95 line), and inline trace ribbon for anomalies.
Micro-interactions: hover over heatmap cell shows mini-metrics card (avg, p50, p95, error-rate) and a CTA to open trace in Trace Viewer.
Token-cost sparkline should decompose on hover into model-cost, kv-cache savings, and batching impact. Default view shows normalized cost per 1k tokens.
Accessibility: ensure color-contrast for heatmap and add pattern overlay for users with color vision deficiency.
Keep screenshots minimal: no personal tokens, sample data only, use synthetic trace IDs prefixed with 'demo-'.
